xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4938: Agent MCP and bots (W-DEL1): Delegation, lanes, issue start, conversation stop and interrupt

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-DEL1): Delegation, lanes, issue start, conversation stop and interrupt
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Managed agents have the overdeck MCP server and agent tokens (W-TOK1, W-MCP1, W-SELF1), but no tool lets an agent delegate a worker and wait for it, run lanes, start an issue, or stop and interrupt a conversation; those still need pan over Bash with the admin internal token. Epic FR-4 requires them as tools with waits bounded at 50 s.
narratives.Proposal: Add owner-checked self routes for delegation (POST /api/self/workers, GET /api/self/workers, GET /api/self/workers/:id, GET /api/self/workers/:id/wait) and lanes (POST /api/self/lanes, POST /api/self/lanes/wait, POST /api/self/lanes/report), with agent-only tools in tools-delegate.ts and tools-lanes.ts; add start_issue, stop_conversation and interrupt_conversation to tools-write.ts over existing routes, with a token-only local branch in POST /api/fleet/issues/:id/start; forward agent-kind tokens to linked machines as that agent (epic D-9). Worker waits pass a startup grace from the worker's launch time so 50 s chunks still detect a dead worker. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4938.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No interrupt for Claude Code, Codex or ACP conversations; interrupt_conversation returns the abort route's Pi-only error text for them.
- No ownership fence on stop_conversation, interrupt_conversation, lane_stop or start_issue beyond the operate scope.
- No force (CPU-pressure override) for lanes started through a tool.
- No single-lane wait (pan lane wait <lane>); lane_wait waits on a run or on the caller's lanes.
- No edits to src/lib/mcp/tools-self.ts, src/dashboard/server/services/self-job-argv.ts or any W-SELF2 route.
- No new HTTP route for stopping a worker; task_cancel uses the existing stop routes.
- No change to the pan CLI's behaviour (worker-remote.ts only re-exports the moved helpers).
- No provenance change for issues started by start_issue.
- No CLAUDE.md, docs/ROLES.md or epic-wide W-DOC pages (bots.mdx, cli/mcp.mdx).

autoDecisions.summary: delegate_task posts a new self route POST /api/self/workers instead of POST /api/fleet/workers
autoDecisions.rationale: The MCP tool context carries no caller identity (McpToolContext is { api, scopes, isAgent }), so only a self route can set issueId and parentId from the token, as epic D-10 requires.

autoDecisions.summary: A conversation's worker parent id is its tmux session conv-<name>
autoDecisions.rationale: pan worker run defaults --parent to OVERDECK_CONVERSATION (the tmux session) and the remote follower keys on the conv- prefix; using the same id keeps pan worker list --parent and the follower working.

autoDecisions.summary: task_status and list_workers are owner-only self routes that include stand-ins; task_cancel adds no route
autoDecisions.rationale: GET /api/workers/:id/status answers 404 for every stand-in (it reads worker.json) and checks no ownership; the epic's own delegate_task accepts machine, so remote workers must work.

autoDecisions.summary: The stand-in wait helpers move to src/lib/agents/worker/wait-any.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: No dashboard server module imports src/cli/commands; moving them keeps one implementation that both the CLI and the wait route use.

autoDecisions.summary: Chunked worker waits pass startupGraceMs computed from the worker's launch time
autoDecisions.rationale: waitForWorkerReport restarts its 60 s grace on every call; with 50 s chunks a dead worker would answer running forever.

autoDecisions.summary: handleFleetIssueStart becomes an Effect generic over R, mirroring handleWorkIssueStart
autoDecisions.rationale: spawnIssueAgentForRoute needs EventStoreService, IssueLifecycle and ReadModelService; machines-work.ts already solves the same door this way.

autoDecisions.summary: Only agent-kind tokens forward as { agentId } on linked machines; conversation tokens stay 'operator' with their ceiling
autoDecisions.rationale: Epic D-9's stated rule is parity with pan, and a conversation's pan acts as the operator today (senderFromEnv -> conv-operator-*); fencing the operator's chat would also break answering linked prompts (W-APPR1).

autoDecisions.summary: lane_start is a self route with the calling conversation as parent, and all lane tools are audience 'agent'
autoDecisions.rationale: A lane's parent must be a conversation and the tool cannot know it; agent-only lane tools keep epic AC-2 (a read:state-only token lists only list_machines).

autoDecisions.summary: lane_wait and lane_report run in process (listLaneViews, collected warnings, the existing lane-report job verb)
autoDecisions.rationale: waitForLaneSet's defaults fetch the dashboard over HTTP and write to stderr; in the server the in-process sources are correct and cheaper.

autoDecisions.summary: Lane tools live in a separate tools-lanes.ts rather than the epic's single tools-delegate.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps each tool file small and lets worker and lane slices be reviewed separately.
